sample_scope: Separate native runs at same camera, epoch and profile; no identical full-raster correspondence claimed. Numeric values decoded from raw RGBA16F, not PNG. Individual points do not establish scene-wide masks.
conclusions: The eight sampled terrain-interior points have zero legacy water weight; heights 4.75-8.25m exceed the classifier band.
Near-datum wet-soil false positives are real in the regular/conforming GPU fixture, but cannot explain the current sampled ground.
Elevated band remains conforming-surface green under unlit geometry output; not the regular skirt.
Some band points read L7 while near points read L17; sampled band distances about100-132m, foreground6-8m.
Both the original policy and ancestry candidate lose the band with 5s prestream; do not credit ancestry for its disappearance.
Albedo and normal views retain broad soil patterns; wet-ground normal/material transport still needs controlled source decomposition.
